 Flyers Recall Forwards Bump and Knuble from Lehigh Valley
 The Flyers have recalled forwards Alex Bump and Cole Knuble from the Lehigh Valley Phantoms.
 By 
 Philadelphia Flyers 
 philadelphiaflyers.com 
 October 19, 2026 
 Link copied 
 The Philadelphia Flyers today announced they have recalled forwards Alex Bump and Cole Knuble from the Lehigh Valley Phantoms of the American Hockey League.
 Both forwards will be available tonight as the Flyers host the Colorado Avalanche at 7:00 p.m. The game can be seen on NBCSP and heard on 97.5 The Fanatic.
